column1: # Extra rules for the reading texts (langpack/texts/*.json), ADR-075. Two sections.
# [forms] -- word forms a text may use although the pack neither attests nor
# generates them (token rule V1 (c)). One tab-separated row per form:
#   form, lemma, upos, unit (a unit code or *), reason
# `lemma` + `upos` give the form its band and frequency checks (V2, V3), so they
# must name a lemma of the pack. Allow-listed forms are NOT written to `wordform`.
# [band-exempt] -- lemmas exempt from the V2 BAND check only (the pack's CEFR label
# is wrong, or the word is core to the topic). They still count in the V3
# frequency gate. One row per lemma:  lemma, upos (or *), unit (or *), reason
# The reason is mandatory (>= 10 characters). Never exempt a rare word.
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
